text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.26 for the Senior Software Engineer position, indicating a low fit. The strongest evidence for their application includes experience with "Node.js", "React", and "AWS", as well as holding a computer science degree. Key gaps include the absence of python and vue.js, as well as having only 1.5 years of experience compared to the implied 4-year requirement. The application has been escalated for further review despite these missing must-have qualifications and low overall fit.
